## Summary:
- This tool is **indexes YouTube** channels, and **generates an RSS** feed based on their transcripts.
- It uses a **language model** to **summarize the transcripts**, and present the main topics.
- The tool can be hosted in a docker image with the following `docker-compose.yaml`:

```yaml
services:
  server:
    image: ghcr.io/markyxp/yt-rss:latest
    container_name: ytrss
    environment:
      - YTRSS_PORT=8000
      - LLM_BASE_URL=https://chatjimmy.ai/api/chat
      - LLM_MODEL_NAME=llama3.1-8B
      - TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL=https://getyoutubetext.com/api/transcript
      - DB_LOCATION=/data/database.db
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Web interface port mapping (host:container)
      - "8000:8000"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "localhost:8000/api/checks/health_check"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  ```

## AI Usage
- While this tool uses a LLM to parse the transcript and generate the RSS feed:
  - LLM has **not** been used to generate any back-end code
  - LLM **has** been used to support generating the front-end, however all the final code has been reviewed (and in most cases re-written) by me.
  - LLM has **not** been used to generate any documentation

All code, documentation, and mistakes were made by me.
